title: Admission gates the run performs
summary: Machine admission journeys never wait on a person. operator_gate admission_owner_approval reads the displayed match code and runs the installed candidate's yoke machines approve CODE over SSH with YOKE_MACHINE_HOME set to the admission fixture's approver home, so the run acts as the already-connected owner; admission_invite_entry runs the owner's yoke invite 'Fixture Teammate' --json and types the code into the wizard's secret prompt, never writing it to evidence. Both refuse keys, print one machine_qa.operator_gate line with self_approving true, and wait up to 600 seconds for completion_text. Failures are admission_owner_approval_context_missing, admission_owner_approval_failed (with the command's exit code and bounded stderr), admission_invite_issue_failed, admission_invite_input_failed, <gate>_rejected, <gate>_timed_out and terminal_setup_exited, each with a recovery. Company sign-in uses machine_browser_approval: the wizard, or the agent driver with --open-link, opens the link in the test machine's browser, the stub identity provider signs in as the fixture teammate, and the gate presses Approve machine.
